title: Radix Sort
definition: Radix Sort arranges numbers digit by digit from least significant digit to most significant digit.
realLifeExample: It is like sorting files first by units digit, then tens digit, then hundreds digit.

algorithm.Iterative:
1. Choose the least significant digit.
2. Place values into buckets by that digit.
3. Collect the buckets in order.
4. Move to the next digit.
5. Repeat until all digits are processed.
algorithm.Functions:
1. Use one function to distribute values into buckets.
2. Use another function to collect them back.
3. Repeat for each digit position.
algorithm.Recursion:
1. Bucket values by the current digit.
2. Rebuild the array.
3. Recurse on the next digit position.
4. Stop after the most significant digit.
